target: hourly recorded Calgary traffic incident count
baseline: Historical mean by weekday_number and hour
collection_gap_rule: Exclude hours inside >48-hour gaps between consecutive recorded incidents.
limitations: Predicts citywide hourly recorded incident activity, not individual crashes.
Airport weather is used as a citywide weather proxy.
Model relationships are predictive associations, not causal effects.
The traffic-incidents archive can contain collection gaps; a conservative >48-hour gap heuristic is used to exclude obvious outages.
